title: 2 Luxury Homes Side-by-Side | 2 Rooftop Hot Tubs
description:
Book both luxury homes for the ultimate Nashville stay! Sleeping up to 24 guests, these modern 4BR retreats each feature a private rooftop lounge, hot tub, and stunning skyline views. Perfect for celebrations, bachelor/ette trips, and group getaways. Just minutes from Broadway, Topgolf, and Nashville’s best dining and nightlife, you’ll have space to gather, relax, and make unforgettable memories.

The space
Together, these two modern 4-bedroom homes create a spacious Nashville retreat. Guests enjoy open living areas, designer furnishings, and private bedrooms with plush bedding. Outdoor gatherings come alive on dual rooftops with hot tubs and panoramic skyline views—perfect for evenings under the city lights.

8 Bedrooms / 8 Bathrooms – sleeps up to 24

Two rooftop patios each with private hot tub and seating

Three King beds + one triple Full bunk per home

Adjacent units for easy access between groups

Premium finishes and fully equipped kitchens

Guest access
Each property is equipped with a Yale smart lock—you’ll receive a personalized entry code in your check-in instructions prior to arrival. No keys to keep track of, and easy self check-in any time after 4 PM.

Other things to note
We’d love to host you, whether you’re visiting for a single night, a month, or even up to six months. At BetterBNB, our mission is to provide a clean, comfortable, and welcoming home where every guest feels cared for.

Your safety and comfort are our top priorities. We take pride in creating a space where you can relax, recharge, and feel at ease during your time in Nashville. Thank you for trusting us with your stay—we look forward to making your experience smooth, stress-free, and memorable.
